definitions.name: Net interest income
definitions.formula: Interest income minus interest expense, as reported (GAAP).

definitions.name: Non-interest income
definitions.formula: Total non-interest income as reported (GAAP).

definitions.name: Total net revenue
definitions.formula: Net interest income plus non-interest income (company-reported revenue tag).

definitions.name: Provision for credit losses
definitions.formula: Provision for credit losses charged to earnings (CECL from 2020; incurred-loss before).
definitions.notes: Basis change at CECL adoption (2020-01-01) — compare across 2019/2020 with care.

definitions.name: Net income
definitions.formula: Net income attributable to the company (GAAP).

definitions.name: Diluted EPS
definitions.formula: Diluted earnings per common share (GAAP).

definitions.name: Total assets
definitions.formula: Total consolidated assets (GAAP, period end).

definitions.name: Total deposits
definitions.formula: Total deposits (GAAP, period end).

definitions.name: Loans held for investment
definitions.formula: Gross loans held for investment before allowance (period end).

definitions.name: Allowance for credit losses
definitions.formula: Allowance for credit losses on loans (period end).

definitions.name: Stockholders' equity
definitions.formula: Total stockholders' equity (period end).

definitions.name: Non-interest expense
definitions.formula: Total non-interest expense (GAAP).

definitions.name: Marketing expense
definitions.formula: Marketing expense as reported.

definitions.name: CET1 capital ratio
definitions.formula: Common equity tier 1 capital / risk-weighted assets (Basel III standardized).
definitions.source_schedule: FR Y-9C HC-R (not XBRL-tagged by these filers)

definitions.name: CET1 capital
definitions.formula: Common equity tier 1 capital dollars (Basel III).

definitions.name: Bank total assets
definitions.formula: Total assets of the insured institution (Call Report).

definitions.name: Bank total deposits
definitions.formula: Total deposits of the insured institution.

definitions.name: Bank net income
definitions.formula: Net income of the insured institution (YTD as reported by RIS).

definitions.name: Bank net loans and leases
definitions.formula: Net loans and leases.

definitions.name: Bank credit card loans
definitions.formula: Credit card loans outstanding.

definitions.name: Bank equity capital
definitions.formula: Total equity capital.

definitions.name: Bank return on assets
definitions.formula: Annualized net income / average assets (as computed by FDIC).

definitions.name: Bank return on equity
definitions.formula: Annualized net income / average equity (as computed by FDIC).

definitions.name: Bank net interest margin
definitions.formula: Net interest income / average earning assets (as computed by FDIC).

definitions.name: Summary of Deposits branch deposits
definitions.formula: Deposits by branch per FDIC SOD survey (June 30 each year), rolled up by state.

definitions.name: Y-9C total assets
definitions.formula: Total consolidated assets per FR Y-9C Schedule HC.

definitions.name: Y-9C total loans and leases
definitions.formula: Loans and leases, net of unearned income (HC-C).

definitions.name: Y-9C credit card loans
definitions.formula: Credit cards and related plans to individuals (HC-C item 6.a).

definitions.name: Y-9C credit card loans past due 30-89 days
definitions.formula: Credit card loans past due 30-89 days and still accruing (HC-N).

definitions.name: Y-9C credit card loans past due 90+ days
definitions.formula: Credit card loans past due 90 days or more and still accruing (HC-N).

definitions.name: Y-9C credit card charge-offs
definitions.formula: Credit card loans charged off, calendar YTD (HI-B).

definitions.name: Y-9C credit card recoveries
definitions.formula: Recoveries on credit card loans, calendar YTD (HI-B).

definitions.name: Y-9C net income
definitions.formula: Net income attributable to holding company, calendar YTD (HI).

definitions.name: Y-9C net interest income
definitions.formula: Net interest income, calendar YTD (HI).

definitions.name: Y-9C total deposits (domestic)
definitions.formula: Domestic interest-bearing plus non-interest-bearing deposits (HC).

definitions.name: Y-9C allowance for credit losses
definitions.formula: Allowance for loan and lease losses / credit losses (HC).

definitions.name: Trust principal receivables
definitions.formula: Principal receivables in the securitization trust at month end.

definitions.name: Trust monthly payment rate
definitions.formula: Principal collections / beginning principal receivables for the monthly period.

definitions.name: Trust portfolio yield (annualized)
definitions.formula: Annualized finance-charge and fee collections / principal receivables.

definitions.name: Trust net charge-off rate (annualized)
definitions.formula: Annualized net principal charge-offs / principal receivables.

definitions.name: Trust 30+ day delinquency rate
definitions.formula: Receivables 30+ days delinquent / total receivables at month end.

definitions.name: Trust excess spread
definitions.formula: Three-month-average excess spread as reported in the servicer report.

definitions.name: CFPB complaint count
definitions.formula: Count of CFPB consumer complaints received in the month, by product.
